emergence.summary: A single-gene SERPINA1 deficiency: the common Z allele (Glu342Lys) mis-folds, so little functional alpha-1-antitrypsin (the principal serpin that inhibits neutrophil elastase) reaches the circulation -> the antiprotease protection of lung tissue is driven DOWN (unopposed elastase -> early emphysema). This is a SUPPLY-DEFICIENCY (loss-of-function) read on the antiprotease axis, and the approved therapy SUPPLIES the missing protein (augmentation). NOTE the disease is genuinely TWO-SIDED: the same Z allele also has a hepatic TOXIC gain-of-function (Z-polymer accumulates in hepatocytes -> liver disease), a DISTINCT axis the single loss-of-function direction here does NOT fold in; an RNAi approach (silencing SERPINA1) targets that hepatic axis and would LOWER circulating A1AT, so it is not a corrective on the antiprotease axis. The gamma read is of the SERPINA1 locus switch structure; the Glu342Lys lesion is a coding change outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: functional circulating alpha-1-antitrypsin (neutrophil-elastase antiprotease protection of lung tissue)

per_gene.note: SERPINA1 encodes alpha-1-antitrypsin, the major circulating inhibitor of neutrophil elastase; the Z allele (Glu342Lys) mis-folds and polymerises, so secreted functional antiprotease falls -> loss of lung antiprotease protection. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the Glu342Lys coding lesion (firewall). The hepatic Z-polymer toxic gain-of-function is a separate axis (see summary), not the primary antiprotease loss read here (SERPINA1 gene OMIM 107400).

falsifiers.claim: SERPINA1 LOF lowers functional circulating antiprotease (lung-protection axis DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: a SERPINA1 deficiency allele that RAISED functional circulating antiprotease / elastase-inhibitory capacity would refute the loss direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: serum functional A1AT level and neutrophil-elastase inhibitory capacity by genotype

falsifiers.claim: augmenting functional A1AT (replace / correct) is the CORRECTIVE direction on the antiprotease axis
falsifiers.falsifier: if raising circulating functional A1AT WORSENED or failed to improve elastase inhibition / lung protection, the augment-A1AT lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: lung elastase-inhibition / emphysema-progression response to A1AT augmentation

falsifiers.claim: the hepatic Z-polymer toxic gain is a DISTINCT axis from the antiprotease loss (not captured by the single LOF direction)
falsifiers.falsifier: if silencing SERPINA1 (clearing hepatic Z-polymer) ALSO improved the antiprotease/lung axis rather than lowering circulating A1AT, the two-axis separation would be wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: hepatic Z-polymer burden vs circulating functional A1AT vs lung function under SERPINA1 silencing
